response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') AS product_color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS total_invoiced, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) / (SELECT SUM(derived_total_cost) FROM Invoice_Line_Items) AS share FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')), color_stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_invoiced) AS avg_per_color FROM color_totals), above_average_colors AS (SELECT ct.total_invoiced, ct.share, cs.avg_per_color FROM color_totals ct CROSS JOIN color_stats cs WHERE ct.total_invoiced > cs.avg_per_color) SELECT AVG(total_invoiced) AS average_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(total_invoiced - avg_per_color) AS average_above_average FROM above_average_colors;
